articles.title: Ghidra + CBMC = Assembly Model Checker

Asmc-lift takes a compiled .elf file and lifts it into a .gb file using the ghidra pcode semantics as packaged by Trail of Bits, and is a driver program that runs asmc-lift and other CBMC tools to perform model checking. This integration is super useful for many use cases, including standalone assembly verification, translation validation, and linking to external assembly, and is relatively small in amount of glue C++ code required.
